findings.description: Pietro Marchetti and Maria Aquilini had a daughter, Giuseppa Marchetti, born in 1884 at Maglianello, Rieti, who died at Rieti on 15 June 1913; the civil death registration names her parents as Pietro and Maria Aquilini.
supporting_sources: Italy, Rieti, Civil Registration (State Archive), 1840-1945 — death registration of Giuseppa Marchetti, Rieti, 15 Jun 1913, born 1884 at Maglianello, father indexed as Pietro (no surname) and mother as Maria Aquilini — ark:/61903/1:1:Q2HC-CWMP
Domenica Marchetti's 1902 Rieti marriage names her parents in full as Pietro Marchetti and Maria Aquilini, anchoring the indexed couple to the known tree couple — ark:/61903/1:1:6K5Z-ZBH9
